title: PLTW Principles of Biomedical Science (PBS)

exam.name: End-of-Course Assessment
exam.note: PLTW courses are project- & problem-based; assessment is largely coursework, a portfolio/lab notebook, and an end-of-course assessment rather than a single AP-style test. Confirm specifics with the teacher.

overview: The first course in Project Lead The Way's Biomedical Science pathway. It's built around a story — investigating the fictional death of a woman named Anna Garcia — and each unit uncovers a disease or body-system concept while you practice real lab skills. This is a hands-on, notebook-driven course: your documentation and lab technique matter as much as the biology facts.
how_to_study_course: Keep your laboratory notebook meticulously — in PLTW it's a graded, ongoing record, not an afterthought.
Connect every activity back to the Anna Garcia case: how does this lab help explain what happened to her?
Learn the lab techniques as transferable skills (measuring, DNA work, documentation) — they carry into the whole pathway (Human Body Systems next).
Biology vocabulary is heavy; make flashcards for disease mechanisms and body-system terms as you go, not at the end.

resources.label: Khan Academy — Biology (background for disease & body systems)
National Institutes of Health — Genetics Home Reference / MedlinePlus

units.title: Unit 1 — The Mystery (investigating a death)
topics: Introduction to the Anna Garcia case
how_to_study: Set up your lab notebook the way the teacher expects on day one
Track the clues — you'll return to them all year

units.title: Unit 2 — Diabetes
topics: Molecules of life: carbohydrates, proteins, lipids
how_to_study: Understand feedback: how insulin controls blood sugar
Know how each macromolecule is built and what it does

units.title: Unit 3 — Sickle Cell Disease
topics: How a single base change causes disease
how_to_study: Trace the path DNA → RNA → protein and where sickle cell breaks it
Practice electrophoresis interpretation — a core biomed skill

units.title: Unit 4 — Heart Disease
how_to_study: Learn blood flow through the heart chambers in order
Connect cholesterol/blood pressure back to the case evidence

units.title: Unit 5 — Infectious Disease & Solving the Mystery
topics: Assembling all evidence to determine cause of death
how_to_study: Pull every unit's evidence together — this is the payoff
Be ready to defend a conclusion with data, like a real investigator
